rollback: Remove env and preserve benchmark report.

problem_solved: Structured generative-AI red-team orchestration and attack strategy testing.

problem_solved: Automated performance, bias, robustness and LLM security testing.

problem_solved: Input/output scanners for prompt injection, PII and unsafe LLM content.

problem_solved: Quality/drift evaluation for model and structured decision outputs.

acceptance: Admit only for a proven visibility gap with lower complexity than extending OTel.

problem_solved: Programmable conversational guardrails and safety rails.

problem_solved: Structured output validation and validators around LLM calls.

acceptance: Admit only if it reduces malformed outputs beyond existing validation.
rollback: Remove adapter and package.

duplication_guard: Playwright remains deterministic baseline and final acceptance authority.

problem_solved: Exploratory browser-agent workflows for complex public research paths.
duplication_guard: Not for deterministic production acceptance or customer-account actions.

rollback: Delete isolated profile/env and revoke pilot key if used.

problem_solved: MCP browser tools using Playwright accessibility snapshots.
duplication_guard: Existing Playwright and coding-agent CLI/skills are preferred for token efficiency.
benchmark: Only benchmark if a connector-facing MCP browser gap is proven.
acceptance: Admit only if tool interoperability outweighs schema/context overhead.
rollback: Remove MCP server config.

problem_solved: Structured web crawl/extraction for market intelligence.
duplication_guard: Crawl4AI, changedetection and deterministic fetch paths already exist in radar.

acceptance: Admit only if unique extraction quality justifies another crawler dependency.
rollback: Remove service/client and keep normalized evidence only.

problem_solved: Deterministic main-text and metadata extraction from public web pages.
duplication_guard: Use before AI extraction where plain HTML is sufficient.

rollback: Remove package; fall back to existing fetch parser.

problem_solved: High-volume controlled crawling with scheduling, retries and pipelines.
duplication_guard: Do not create a second scheduler or broad crawler until source volume proves need.

acceptance: Admit only if it materially reduces founder/agent runtime versus current source adapters.
rollback: Remove crawler project and package.

problem_solved: Deterministic RSS/Atom ingestion for regulatory, company and technology signals.
duplication_guard: Only for official or attributable feeds; no feed item becomes opportunity automatically.

rollback: Remove package and disable feed adapters.

problem_solved: Evidence snapshot/archive of public pages used in opportunity and proof decisions.
duplication_guard: Do not build a second truth store or archive unrelated personal data.

acceptance: Admit only if durable source preservation cannot be met by current receipt snapshots.
rollback: Delete archive service/data after sanitized export.

problem_solved: High-accuracy multilingual document parsing for tenders, reports and scanned packs.

problem_solved: PDF/document conversion to structured Markdown for downstream analysis.
duplication_guard: Compare with Docling/MinerU; one canonical parser should win per document class.

problem_solved: Multi-format partitioning/chunking for enterprise document ingestion.
duplication_guard: Docling/Marker/MinerU already cover the primary document-intelligence gap.

acceptance: Admit only for a measured unsupported-format gap.
rollback: Remove package/service.

problem_solved: OCR fallback for scanned Arabic/English images and difficult PDFs.

rollback: Remove models/env.

problem_solved: Fast deterministic PDF text/page/image inspection and preprocessing.
duplication_guard: Not a semantic document brain; use as low-level utility before heavier parsers.

problem_solved: Lightweight pure-Python PDF metadata, text, merge/split and form utilities.
duplication_guard: Avoid duplicate heavy parsing; use for simple deterministic operations only.

rollback: Remove package and use existing PDF tooling.

problem_solved: Fine-grained PDF text/table geometry extraction for evidence packs.
duplication_guard: Fallback only for table/layout cases unresolved by canonical parser.
benchmark: Measure table extraction on 5 difficult PDFs.
acceptance: Admit only for unique table accuracy.
rollback: Remove package.

problem_solved: Probabilistic entity resolution across company/contact/source records.
duplication_guard: RapidFuzz remains simple deterministic baseline; no automatic relationship creation.
benchmark: Resolve a sanitized duplicate-company fixture with known truth labels.
acceptance: Improves precision/recall versus current fuzzy matching at bounded complexity.
rollback: Remove package/models and keep deterministic fallback.

problem_solved: Entity deduplication and record linkage for noisy contact/account data.
duplication_guard: Compare with Splink; only one advanced probabilistic linker should be admitted.

problem_solved: DataFrame/schema validation for research, proof and analytics pipelines.

problem_solved: Python security lint for common insecure coding patterns.

problem_solved: Python dependency license inventory for commercial distribution diligence.

problem_solved: SPDX/REUSE license and copyright compliance checks for source files.
